checks.exercise: Distinct full-can-raise scaption motion inspected in front and side sheets
checks.setup: 양발을 고정하고 덤벨을 든 채 팔을 몸 옆보다 약간 앞쪽에 둔다.
checks.hands: Thumb-side grip axis points up at raised position; wrists aligned with forearms
checks.feet: Both feet and trunk remain fixed
checks.movement: 엄지가 위를 향하도록 잡고 팔을 앞쪽 대각선으로 어깨 높이 아래까지 올렸다가 내린다.

limitations: Procedural shoulder/forearm rotations; no physiological muscle simulation or full mesh collision certification.
Arm elevation limited below shoulder height; small fixed elbow bend.
Virtual floor at -7.9; no floor visible. Source study is a motion reference, not clinical suitability certification.
